# Kit photographs: generation prompts

Generated by the maintainer with Nano Banana (web) on 2026-11-15 from these prompts, one image per type (2752 × 1536), then
resized to WebP by Claude (`<type>.webp` 1600 px, `<type>-sm.webp` 600 px). No maker's livery, no lettering.
To regenerate a type, reuse its prompt (keep the camera wording so the six stay consistent), then update
`KIT_SPOTS` (the lit hotspots) in `js/golem-pedals.js`.

## rock

```
Photorealistic product photograph of a complete acoustic drum kit in a recording studio, seen from just behind and above the drummer's empty throne, raised camera looking down and forward across the whole kit: snare drum and hi-hat closest at the bottom left, rack toms mounted over the bass drum, floor tom on the right, the bass drum's batter head with its pedal and beater in the centre foreground, cymbals on stands at realistic heights. Warm soft studio lighting, wooden plank floor, a grey rug under the kit, dark acoustic panels in the blurred background, shallow depth of field. Wide 16:9 framing with the whole kit visible and some space around it. Absolutely no logos, no brand names, no text, no lettering anywhere on drums, heads or cymbals. A rock kit: 22-inch bass drum, two rack toms, one 16-inch floor tom, a 14-inch snare, hi-hat, an 18-inch crash and a 22-inch ride. Deep red gloss lacquer shells, chrome hardware, white coated heads, bronze cymbals.
```
